notes.title: Update 0.8.4, Fixes and Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have a smaller feature patch, and some bugfixes for you today!

[b]First lets start with the bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tomatoes no longer grow and result in beef
[*] CPU was incorrectly priced
[*] Shotgun upgrade fixed
[*] Issue when swapping weapons in the middle of a shotgun reload causing you to not be able to fire pistols
[*] Added waypoint for Featherweight fortune mission
[*] Fixed bug with upgrade menu sometimes selecting a melee weapon if its the first item in your inventory
[*] Fixed preview mesh for scope upgrade for Desert Falcon 
[*] .223 were mislabeled as .308 in some places
[*] You now only need 3 bottles of vodka instead of 10 to complete "Gravediggers Stash"
[/list]

We also decided to release a [b]roadmap system[/b], which will help us steer this games development with the feedback from the players!
You can find the roadmap ingame in the login menu, but also on our website: https://desyncdonkeys.com

In order to vote on what you would like to see us focus on, please vote in the game! 
[i][b]PS! [/b][/i]You can vote on one item once per day to prevent abuse.

notes.title: We're Back, Survivors!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/aa89e84914767ef0543a472d972f351c0c966a4c.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that Lifeless is officially back on the Steam store and available for purchase again! 

Since re-enabling the game for our loyal previous owners, we've received amazing feedback and tremendous support from the community, [b]thank you all so much[/b]!

We have been working tirelessly since 2021 to bring the game to a state that we can feel proud of. It is not perfect, but it's a damn good base for us to continue building upon. And with your support, we are confident we will get there.

[h3]Still in Early Access, Still Improving[/h3]
Lifeless remains in Early Access, but rest assured, our dedication to this game has never been stronger. We’re committed to continuous development, bug fixing, and bringing exciting new content your way.


[h3]Recap: What’s New Since Our Return[/h3]
If you missed our previous announcement, here's a quick recap of the features we've introduced since reacquiring the rights to the game in 2021:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/e03eec798f0c53cd1f052771c099113d76446e06.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Upgraded the engine to Unreal Engine 5.4.4
[*] The game is now Co-Op and SIngleplayer
[*] Completely New World Map, including the exciting Wasteland
[*] Added a travel mechanic with Otis' Copter Network! Flight Points are now useable to make traveling large distances not quite as boring
[*] 2 New enemy types (total of [b]4[/b] now!)
[*] Wild animals to hunt / skin
[*] Crafting system
[*] Growing system
[*] Player Housing and building
[*] Missions with a story 
[*] Gathering (trees, bushes, etc)
[*] Weapon Upgrades for ALL firearms, including active upgrades
[*] Skills
[*] Achievements
[*] Roaming NPCs
[*] 1000+ bug fixes and optimisations
[*] New Melee combat code
[*] Many new UI improvements
[*] Over 250 items in the game
[*] Voiced dialogue system for NPCs
[*] Cutscenes
[*] And much, much more
[/list]

Additionally, since our previous announcement, we've implemented:
[list]
[*] Implemented foundations for Mod Support
[*] Even more performance optimizations
[*] Improved multiplayer stability
[*] Added more detailed environmental interactions
[/list]
[h3]A Passion Project[/h3]
We want to emphasize that Lifeless is still created by just two dedicated developers. myself and [b]H[/b], in our spare time. Every feature, every fix, cup of coffee, every improvement comes from countless late-night sessions after our full-time jobs. 

Your ongoing support means everything to us.


[h3]Your Voice Matters, Join Our Discord![/h3]
We believe strongly in community-driven development. Your feedback directly influences the future direction of Lifeless. Want your voice heard? Have suggestions, bug reports, or just want to chat with fellow survivors? Join our Discord here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/77ee5f171ce8a44471f942a8e36a82aeb1983922.png[/img]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/KMzgGsPR]https://discord.gg/KMzgGsPR[/url][/b]

Thank you for your continued support. Together, we’re building the Lifeless we always dreamed it could be.

See you out there,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/e79f3f351bbdf931c75246b22837944ef881d95f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/ae28c1cfb5f615829d2b088bb91d9a2208805232.png[/img]

notes.title: Lifeless Update 0.8.3
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

Update 0.8.3 contains the changes below. Aside from several dozen bug fixes and tweaks, these are the most note-worthy changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/e03eec798f0c53cd1f052771c099113d76446e06.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Crazy Tony", an interactible NPC next to Freehaven with 3 brand new missions! He can be found on top of the gas station outside Freehaven.
[*] Added additional missions to ship players between Lea and Luke
[*] Added a new NPC with 3 missions in Freehaven
[*] Added a smelting and mining robot that players can build and use to mine ores and smelt metals
[*] Added a whole new set of metal building blocks!
[/list]

[b]Noteworthy Level Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Two out of the three main safezones in the Wasteland now have NPCs and missions.
[*] There is a chain of missions that guide you to Fort Horizon as well as Dustspire in the Wasteland
[*] Dustspire is now inhabited by the Scrapping guild, along with their Robot helpers
[*] Added a garbage station to the level in the Wasteland
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a travel mechanic with Otis' Copter Network! Flight Points are now useable to make traveling large distances not quite as boring
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Repaired broken music slider in settings
[*] Fixed broken collision on scaffolding
[*] Fixed bugs regarding respawning of gaterable trees
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who reports bugs, and we hope you enjoy these changes! :)

notes.title: Lifeless is back! And this time for good!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Survivors[/h3]
We hope you’re all holding up well out there. We’ve got some big news to share with you, and we couldn’t be more excited!

[h3]A New Beginning[/h3]
As you may know, Lifeless had a rough start. We always believed in the game’s potential, but various issues kept it from being the post-apocalyptic adventure we dreamed it could be. Despite those setbacks, we never gave up on that vision.

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve (myself and H) fully reacquired the rights to Lifeless and have been hard at work for the past few years (since 2021 to be exact) to bring you the game we always promised.

Myself and [b]H[/b] are the only developers on the game since we managed to re-acquire the game in 2021, and we are doing this in our free time outside of our full-time dayjobs. This is also why it has taken some time to get to this point.

We’ve upgraded “Lifeless” to the latest Unreal Engine 5, fixed all the old issues, and added a [b]ton[/b] of new features to make the game better than ever. 

This has truly been a labor of love for us, we’ve been developing this game for over 10 years without making [b]any[/b] profit because it’s a passion project. And at this point, it’s about finishing what we set out to do in the first place.

[h3]So what is new?[/h3]
A lot, but first of all, Lifeless now runs on Unreal Engine 5.4.4 and the game is now a single player, co-op experience. This may be controversial to some (who love PVP), but I will outline below why we came to this decision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11522721/e03eec798f0c53cd1f052771c099113d76446e06.png[/img]

There are two main reasons for this change, [b]availability[/b] and [b]cheating[/b].
We want you to feel safe that once you play Lifeless, it can never be taken away from you. This means that we also dont want the game to have to rely on [b]ANY [/b] infrastructure that you are not in control of.

This way even if we get hit by a bus and development stops, you can always play Lifeless. Secondly, even if we enabled large PVP worlds, it would be infested and ruined by cheaters. If massive corporations cant solve this problem, it would be naive to think that we could.

[b]Of course[/b], you can still invite friends to play with you, since the multiplayer option is still there.
Additionally, these new features have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Completely New World Map
[*] 2 New enemy types (total of [b]4[/b] now!)
[*] Wild animals to hunt / skin
[*] Crafting system
[*] Growing system
[*] Player Housing and building
[*] Missions with a story 
[*] Gathering (trees, bushes, etc)
[*] Weapon Upgrades for ALL firearms, including active upgrades
[*] Skills
[*] Achievements
[*] Roaming NPCs
[*] 1000+ bug fixes and optimisations
[*] New Melee combat code
[*] Many new UI improvements
[*] Over 250 items in the game
[*] Voiced dialogue system for NPCs
[*] Cutscenes
[*] And much, much more
[/list]

[h3]So when can I play?[/h3]
If you already own the game, we have already updated it and you can download it and play [b]right now![/b]

[h3]What is next?[/h3]
First and foremost we want to make sure the game is stable and has good performance. Once that is confirmed and we have ironed out any bugs, we want to engage our community and with [b]your [/b]help we will decide where our next efforts should lie. New missions? New zombies? New areas? Spaceships? Mod support? -[b] you decide.[/b]

I hope you enjoy the game, we have really worked many late evenings and put a lot of effort into making it the best we can. And we look forward to another 10 years of Lifeless.

[b]K & H[/b]

[b]PS![/b] Join our Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/7dUQjFKG8y]https://discord.gg/7dUQjFKG8y[/url]) or reach out in the discussions forum to give us feedback or report bugs!

notes.title: Lifeless Patch!
notes.content:
Hi guys, it's been a while (we know) but we're not gone!

Here's a little patch, we had to hurry it out a bit faster than intended, since an update to the anticheat made it impossible to play the game, which was out of our hands.

You should now be able to play fine again!

Some simple patchnotes:

- Screamer scream lowered by 50%

- High pitch ringing sound after screamer screames lowered by 90%

- Blurred vision for dazed status effect is less intense

- Tweaked fog settings in Stillwater Bay

- Optimized thousands of objects in the game, this should reduce hitches and lag for some people.

- Balanced and tweaked damage, block amount, crit chance and recoil for weapons

- Balanced and tweaked stats for consumables

- Balanced and tweaked durability and armor for gear


We also fixed several code bugs that are not as interesting to post about, but will help overall gameplay.

Have fun guys!

notes.title: Update V0.7 LIVE - Safe Zones, Economy and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/66QW61M.jpg[/img]

Hello, and welcome to [b]Lifeless[/b]. If you've been here before, we've got a whole load of new features in our biggest update yet. If you're just joining us, welcome to the party - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zy4pmgiObw8]Take a look at our all new trailer[/url]!

At the core, Lifeless is a zombie survival game set in the fictional town of Stillwater Bay in Maine. At the start of the game, you pick from two different factions - The crazed, militant Spartan Phalanx; or the civilian survivors of the Nova Guard. By picking a faction, you already have a set of team mates that you can work with to survive in this harsh, hostile land.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nQYqWfj.gif[/img]

In this latest update, we've [i]tripled[/i] the amount of content in the game. Here's some of the new features - 

[list]
[*][b]Safe Zones[/b] - New areas for both factions that allow players to socialise in safety, without the threat of attack from other players and zombies!
[*][b]Economy[/b] - Collect scraps in the world to take back to your safe zone
[*][b]Skills[/b] - Available from a trainer in the safe zones, players can trade scraps to learn a variety of abilities to help turn the tide of battle
[*][b]New Weapons[/b] - Get your hands on an AK-47, a Desert Eagle, the often community request Bolt action rifle and more!
[*][b]PvP Event[/b] - The first event allows players to capture an air drop and bring it back to their bases for a faction wide reward. Watch out, because the other faction will want it too...
[*][b]New Zombie[/b] - The Screamer will stalk the world with other zombies, and will strike when you least expect it...
[*][b]Storage[/b] - Save your scraps and rare weapons at the Storage deposit at your safe zone
[/list]

And much more! [url=http://lifelessgame.com/]You can see the full list of improvements over on our website[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/f5paKZ6.gif[/img]

That's just some of what we've been working on over the past few months, and we're only just getting started. We love seeing your videos, your posts on the community, and all the suggestions you write to us. Our community makes this game, and we'd be nothing without you, so thank you! 

Can't wait to see you in Stillwater Bay.

/ Rigid-Soft and Green Man Gaming Publishing

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.6.5 - "The Coghammer"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11522721/63db38da1ceaade8280659ba96f513c25b07b93f.png[/img]

Hi guys!

It is time! The first content + bugfix patch is here!

[b]Before we get any further, let me make clear we are continuously working on all the issues you guys face, and if you have any problems that didn't get fixed in this patch, they are still being worked on. Don't worry, you have not been forgotten![/b]

So what does 0.6.5 include you say? Oh so many things... Weapons... And other stuff, nothing special.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
6 New weapons! These have been in the pipeline and were just added, fresh (ish) out of the pipeline. For you guys enjoyment! Fight guys, fight!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11522721/822e3f612995ca4ff0b960b220da42c285c9cfbe.png[/img]

[olist]
    [*]Leadpipe
    [*]Frying pan
    [*]Machete
    [*]Tanto
    [*]Saw Sword
    [*]Pipe Hammer
[/olist]


[h1]Main Changes[/h1]

[b]Performance[/b]
We have managed to fix a lot of the memory leaks and performance hogs associated with those. This will be happening with every patch, as it's an ongoing process. Most likely wont stop doing this, ever.

As always a good tip for extra frames is running the game in normal fullscreen instead of windowed mode.

[b]No Character List / Creating Character[/b]
A small subset of users had this issue, and we believe it's been fixed. The people that had it that we have tested with, have been able to play normally now :).

[h1]Other important stuff[/h1]

[b]Changes/Fixes[/b]
[olist]
  [*]Dropped items falling through concrete intersections fixed
  [*]2H Sharp Weapons blocking fixed
  [*]Smoother general movement
  [*]Item & interactables highlight layering fixed
  [*]Water surface lowered, to combat the prone underwater exploit
  [*]Lots of backpacks spawning is fixed
  [*]Icon fix for some boots
  [*]Lots of animation fixes
  [*]Lots of collision fixes on certain houses and objects
  [*]Updated Flashlight light
  [*]Certain Anti Cheat crashes have been fixed on startup
[/olist]


[b]Optimisation Changes[/b]
[olist]
    [*]~ 1GB in texture optimizations
    [*]Many underlying optimization changes
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.6.4 - "Italian Meatballs"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11522721/2e138dbd142f56458b4c8d9c430894a16aa15a11.png[/img]

Hi guys!

After a lot of coffee, hard work, and little sleep. We are happy to announce 0.6.4!

[b]But before I get into the nitty-gritty I wanted to let you guys know that IF you guys don't get characters when you log in after this update. PLEASE restart STEAM![/b]

So what does 0.6.4 include? Lots! But mainly a ton of optimizations and fixes! Without further ado:

[h1]Main Changes[/h1]

[b]Frame Rate Improvement[/b]
The game should run a lot smoother now, we put in a lot of optimisations that should help most people run the game much smoother. Reported framerate improvements for most people have been from roughly 15-20 FPS before this patch, to 55-60 in most cases.

A good tip for extra frames is running the game in normal fullscreen instead of windowed mode.

[b]Joining Issues[/b]
This issue has been a big one. And we think we have mitigated this issue for most people. To try to nail this down we invited a group of people with the issue to try out an internal build, after lots of tweaks, downloads and fixes. Everyone in the test group was able to join and play the game.

[h1]Smaller but also important stuff[/h1]

[b]Graphical Changes[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Removed collision on small objects that players could get stuck on
    [*]Added collision on trees that did'nt have collision
    [*]Further balancing of item spawn time- and rate
    [*]Optimized render distance, culling and shadows on objects far away
[/olist]

[b]Gameplay Changes/Fixes[/b]
[olist]
  [*]Zombies keep quiet after dying, and their different sounds are better intertwined.
  [*]First Person / Third Person reload / etc issues fixed
  [*]No more crazy camera upon death
  [*]You can now use "Y" for VOIP as well
[/olist]


[b]Optimisation Changes[/b]
[olist]
  [*]Major cleanout of PhysX actions of zombies & players, much smaller workload for the CPU.
  [*]Aggressive distance culling of unseen objects, less GPU workload.
  [*]Proper distance culling of players and zombies
  [*]Amount of objects in the world minimized and put together into fewer but larger objects, easier for occlusion. 
  [*]As a result of a cleaner world, loading times not as long
  [*]Previous login fails caused by Steam Connection Timeout, prolonged timeout threshold to allow more people in and hopefully no more connection issues.
  [*]Culling of smaller objects improved
  [*]Disabled distance field shadows on smaller objects that never cast visible shadows anyway
[/olist]

[b]PS:[/b] This direction of optimization has barely begun but we've noticed a good enough performance to push this up to you guys. We will keep optimizing further!
